---
title: Troubleshooting
---

Start with the exact error, package version and loaded path. Retrying with
different scientific settings can change the question without solving the problem.

## Repository access is denied

Check Git availability and whether your GitHub account can access IOBR/IOBRcausal.
Use your normal Git credential manager. Keep tokens out of commands saved in
scripts or reports. A private repository may return 404 to an anonymous client.

## R loads an older package

```r
packageVersion("IOBRcausal")
find.package("IOBRcausal")
.libPaths()
```

Restart R after installing an update. Check child Rscript processes as well as
the interactive session when multiple libraries exist.

## The terminal cannot find iobrcausal

The package launcher can be called from R without adding it to PATH:

```r
launcher <- system.file("exec", "iobrcausal.R", package = "IOBRcausal")
rscript <- file.path(R.home("bin"),
  if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows") "Rscript.exe" else "Rscript")
system2(rscript, c(shQuote(launcher), "start"))
```

For Skill installation, also check `node --version`, `npm --version` and
`git --version`. The documented standalone command requires Node.js 22.20 or later.

## A method was skipped

Read the method-specific reason. Typical causes are an unsupported
exposure/outcome/target combination, insufficient support or a missing optional
dependency. A skip is different from a fitted null effect or an attempted failure.

## No candidates were retained

Check the requested family, missingness, sample/event counts, gene-set coverage,
configured gates and full audit tables. A completed workflow with no retained
candidates is a valid result. Keep it distinct from a failed or incomplete stage.

## Excel or a figure is missing

Inspect the actual artifact list, writer dependency status and validation output.
Look for an explicitly reported CSV fallback. Saved-number plots need matching
numeric evidence; a survival curve needs a saved curve cache.

## Share a useful issue

Include the minimal synthetic input, request, exact error, version, session
information and the stage that failed. Remove patient identifiers and credentials.
Use the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/IOBR/IOBRcausal/issues).
